title: [BFC 26-054] - Board discussion regarding a possible proposal to amend Los Angeles
text:
[5. REGULAR AGENDA ITEMS]
[BFC 26-054] - Board discussion regarding a possible proposal to amend Los Angeles
  Municipal Code section 41.18(C)(5) to include public safety facilities as areas where
  sitting, lying, or sleeping or storing, using, maintaining, or placing personal property is
  prohibited.
summary: Board discussion of proposal to amend Los Angeles Municipal Code section 41.18(C)(5) to prohibit sitting, lying, and sleeping at public safety facilities.
